text:
Marta: quick heads-up — onboarding feedback: python SDK errors are too vague, TS throws typed errors. can we converge on a single ergonomic surface?
Sahil: +1. Support got a 502 and the message was just 'request failed'. user blamed their code. we should include an action hint and code.
Kevin: parity pain: error class names differ across libs. Suggest canonical set: AuthError, PermissionError, NotFoundError, RateLimitError, TimeoutError, ServerError, StreamError.
Olivia: docs ask: what should the short user message look like? my take: one short sentence + one clear next step + link. e.g., 'Rate limit exceeded. Retry in Xs or reduce concurrency. See /docs/throughput.'
Sahil: sketch HTTP mapping I sent support:
```
401 -> AuthError(code="invalid_api_key", retryable=false)
403 -> PermissionError(code="policy_denied", retryable=false)
404 -> NotFoundError(code="model_not_found", retryable=false)
408/504 -> TimeoutError(code="upstream_timeout", retryable=true)
429 -> RateLimitError(code="rate_limit", retryable=true, retry_after=secs)
5xx -> ServerError(code="server_error", retryable=true)
```
Kevin: implementation note: throw native Error subclass and attach structured fields (error.code, error.retryable, error.request_id, error.hint_url). keeps try/catch idiomatic but machine-friendly.
Marta: include machine code in human message too so logs are searchable (e.g., '(code=rate_limit)'). also require request_id always present.
Olivia: onboarding tweak: add a small 'How to report an error' line telling users to paste code + request_id. reduces back-and-forth.
ops-bot: Created task RDW-UX-1301: "SDK error ergonomics: canonical classes + mapping + docs" assigned to @sahil, @kevin, due 2026-04-09.
Sahil: I'll prototype python + ts changes (enum of codes + runtime mapping) and post a WIP PR.
Kevin: don't forget streaming: StreamError should include recoverable flag and position token index.
Marta: thanks team. small surface change but big DX win. :thumbsup:
